text: What if gravity doubled for five seconds? Bad news. You just got twice as heavy.
Your knees fold. Everyone standing hits the floor. Cheap chairs? Snapped.
Every shelf on Earth is holding double. Your whole kitchen? Gone.
Every plane drops a hundred meters. Inside? The coffee doesn't even spill.
Every bungee jumper goes way lower. Hair in the river lower.
The gym guy benching his max? It just doubled. Safety pins. Thank God.
Gravity is back. Everyone pushing off the floor jumps. By accident.
Somewhere, a guy stepped on a scale at second three. He's on a diet now. It was five seconds, man.
What should double next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
